## How this works

<ul class="points">
<li>
<h3>Open data</h3>
Built only from published, free-to-use sources: data.gov.bn, the World Bank, FAOSTAT and ILOSTAT. [See sources](sources.qmd).
</li>
<li>
<h3>Every number credited</h3>
Each chart names the agency that published the data and the date it was accessed.
</li>
<li>
<h3>Independent</h3>
Independent analysis and transformations, not official statistics. [Data use policy](data-policy.qmd) · [How AI was used](about.qmd#how-ai-was-used).
</li>
</ul>
